lines.speaker: B

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I want chicken rice. You?

lines.en: I don't want chicken rice — I want noodles.

lines.zh: 没关系，小贩中心什么都有。
lines.en: No problem, the hawker centre has everything.

lines.speaker: B

lines.en: Too expensive! Can you make it cheaper?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Okay lah, four fifty.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'll take two.

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 安哥，请问，地铁站怎么走？
lines.en: Uncle, excuse me, how do I get to the MRT station?

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 你一直直走，然后在红绿灯左转。
lines.en: Go straight, then turn left at the traffic light.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Is it far?

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 不远，走路五分钟就到了。
lines.en: Not far — five minutes on foot.

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 我要去樟宜机场，要转车吗？
lines.en: I'm going to Changi Airport — do I need to transfer?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, you need to change trains once.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thank you, uncle!

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: You're welcome, take care!

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: It's going to rain! Bring in the laundry, quick!

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Okay, going now.

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 你去巴刹的时候带雨伞。
lines.en: Take an umbrella when you go to the market.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: We still need to go to the market today?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yes, there's no food left at home.

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 那我先去倒垃圾，再去巴刹。
lines.en: Then I'll take out the rubbish first, then go to the market.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Okay. Remember to switch off the air-con before you leave!

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I know lah!

lines.en: Got a girlfriend yet? When are you getting married?

lines.en: Manager, I'm not feeling well today — I'd like to take sick leave.

lines.en: What's wrong?

lines.en: I have a fever and a cough.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Have you seen a doctor?

lines.speaker: A

lines.en: Yes, the doctor gave me two days' MC.

lines.zh: 好，你好好休息。今天的会我来开。
lines.en: Okay, rest well. I'll run today's meeting.

lines.en: Thank you, and sorry about this.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No problem — your health comes first.

lines.en: Have you finished your homework?

lines.en: Not yet — Chinese is so hard!

lines.en: I don't get it — can you go slower?

lines.en: Thanks, Mum!

lines.en: Thank you, Grandma! Gong xi fa cai!

lines.en: Long time no see! How've you been?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Not bad lah, work's busy. You?

lines.zh: 一样咯。周末要不要去圣淘沙？
lines.en: Same lor. Want to go to Sentosa this weekend?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure! But will it rain?

lines.en: Usually it doesn't rain in the morning — let's go early.

lines.speaker: B

lines.en: You're so kiasu — leaving at six?

lines.zh: 不是啦，早点去比较凉快嘛。
lines.en: Not lah, it's cooler if we go early mah.

lines.en: Okay lah okay lah, whatever you say.
